abstract: Over the past year, the Advanced Media Workflow Association (AMWA) has focused on three main objectives: • Growing adoption of Networked Media Open Specifications (NMOS) by improving industry understanding of the specifications fit into IP-based infrastructures. • Enhancing and expanding NMOS specifications to address evolving user challenges. • Developing tools to streamline NMOS adoption.
